```bash
const fs = require('fs')
const path = require('path')

const root = '/Users/liamellis/Desktop/apps/ultraterrestrial-resurrection'
const donor = path.join(root, 'docs/design/reference-prototype')
const dest = path.join(
  root,
  'apps/app/src/components/design-system/research-ui/documents/reference-prototype'
)

function ensureDir(d) {
  fs.mkdirSync(d, { recursive: true })
}

function write(file, content) {
  ensureDir(path.dirname(file))
  fs.writeFileSync(file, content)
}

function relImport(fromFile, toFile) {
  let rel = path.relative(path.dirname(fromFile), toFile).replace(/\\/g, '/')
  if (!rel.startsWith('.')) rel = './' + rel
  // strip extension for TS imports
  rel = rel.replace(/\.tsx?$/, '')
  return rel
}

// file map: dest-relative -> donor-absolute
const files = [
  ['types/documents.ts', 'types/documents.ts'],
  ['PhotoCaption.tsx', 'components/ui/PhotoCaption.tsx'],
  ['DocumentFrame.tsx', 'components/DocumentFrame.tsx'],
  ['DocumentOne.tsx', 'components/DocumentOne.tsx'],

  ['vintage-posters/VintagePosterD.tsx', 'components/vintage-posters/VintagePosterD.tsx'],
  ['vintage-posters/index.ts', 'components/vintage-posters/index.ts'],
]

ensureDir(dest)

for (const [destRel, donorRel] of files) {
  const destFile = path.join(dest, destRel)
  const donorFile = path.join(donor, donorRel)
  let src = fs.readFileSync(donorFile, 'utf8')

  const typesPath = path.join(dest, 'types/documents.ts')
  const photoPath = path.join(dest, 'PhotoCaption.tsx')
  const docA = path.join(dest, 'DocumentA.tsx')

  const docFrame = path.join(dest, 'DocumentFrame.tsx')
  const vintageIndex = path.join(dest, 'vintage-posters/index.ts')

  // Rewrite known absolute aliases to relative or app paths
  const replacements = [
    [/@\/types\/documents?/g, () => relImport(destFile, typesPath)],
    [/@\/components\/ui\/PhotoCaption/g, () => relImport(destFile, photoPath)],
    [/@\/components\/DocumentA/g, () => relImport(destFile, docA)],

    [/@\/components\/vintage-posters/g, () => relImport(destFile, vintageIndex)],
    [/@\/lib\/fonts/g, () => '@/app/fonts'],
    // @/lib/utils and @/components/ui/card stay
  ]

  for (const [re, fn] of replacements) {

}
```

```bash
files.forEach(f=>console.log(' -', path.relative(dest,f)));
// validate relative imports resolve
let bad=0;
for(const f of files){
  const t=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');
  for(const m of t.matchAll(/from ['\"](\.[^'\"]+)['\"]/g)){
    let rel=m[1];
    const base=path.resolve(path.dirname(f),rel);
    const candidates=[base, base+'.ts', base+'.tsx', path.join(base,'index.ts'), path.join(base,'index.tsx')];
    if(!candidates.some(c=>fs.existsSync(c))){console.log('MISSING', path.relative(dest,f), '->', rel); bad++;}
  }
}
console.log(bad?`broken relative imports: ${bad}`:'all relative imports resolve');
EOF
```
